scenes.line1: Does your UI help or harm?
scenes.say: Ever wondered if your interface could actually make some users dizzy or leave others unable to read your text?

scenes.label: Contrast
scenes.sub: Text needs enough contrast with its background. WCAG AA says at least four point five to one.
scenes.say: Text must stand out from its background. The rule? At least four point five to one contrast ratio for normal text.
To reduce motion for users who need it, use the prefers reduced motion media query. This disables animations if someone requests less movement.

scenes.question: Is AAA contrast always required?
scenes.wrong: Yes, AAA is always the goal.
scenes.right: No, AA is the practical standard; AAA is stricter and not always achievable.
scenes.say: Here's a common trap: Interviewers might ask if you always need to hit the strictest contrast standard. Remember, AA is the baseline—AAA is nice, but not always practical.
